about: The secreta of the formulary “Saint Mark the Evangelist” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Bringing gifts to Thee on the solemnity of blessed Mark, Thy Evangelist, we beseech Thee, O Lord, that, as the preaching of the Gospel made him glorious, so his intercession may render us acceptable to Thee both in word and in deed. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
